description: Confirm the DYF-11 ordered-region boundaries from pLDDT and place the alignment-derived IFT20 interface
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
pdb=requests.get(requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q17595",timeout=120).json()[0]["pdbUrl"],timeout=300).text
pl={}
for l in pdb.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA": pl[int(l[22:26])]=float(l[60:66])
res=np.array(sorted(pl)); b=np.array([pl[r] for r in res])
for a,z,lab in [(3,111,"NN-CH"),(112,423,"linker"),(424,528,"IFT20-interface equivalent (alignment-derived)"),(529,535,"C-tail")]:
    v=[pl[r] for r in range(a,z+1) if r in pl]
    print(f"{lab:48s} {a}-{z}  n={len(v):3d}  mean pLDDT {np.mean(v):5.1f}")
# ordered C-terminal block defined directly from pLDDT>70
ordered=[r for r in res if pl[r]>70 and r>150]
print("\nresidues >150 with pLDDT>70:",min(ordered),"-",max(ordered),"n=",len(ordered))
runs=[];s=ordered[0];p=ordered[0]
for r in ordered[1:]:
    if r>p+3: runs.append((s,p)); s=r
    p=r
runs.append((s,p))
print("contiguous ordered blocks:",[(a,z,z-a+1) for a,z in runs if z-a>=10])

CONS={"Q441":94,"L450":94,"D460":94,"E467":94,"W471":94,"I528":94,"P449":88,"M464":88,"N524":88,
      "L468":81,"I507":81,"L496":75,"L503":69,"E525":69,"S446":62}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,4))
ax.plot(res,b,lw=1.1,color="#2b6cb0")
ax.axvspan(3,111,color="#2f855a",alpha=.13,label="NN-CH domain 3-111 (mean pLDDT 89.8)")
ax.axvspan(424,528,color="#dd6b20",alpha=.13,label="IFT20 interface equivalent 424-528 (alignment to 8RUY)")
for k,v in CONS.items():
    ax.plot(int(k[1:]),102,marker="v",color="#c53030",ms=4)
ax.text(476,106,"15 interface positions identical in >=50% of 16 orthologs",ha="center",fontsize=7.5,color="#c53030")
ax.set_xlabel("DYF-11 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(0,112)
ax.set_title("DYF-11 two-module architecture: ordered CH domain and ordered IFT20-binding coiled coil separated by a disordered linker",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower center")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
